title.en: Old Words, Ordinary Choices: five new complete editions
title.zh: 旧词，眼前的事：新增五语全文
title.zh-hant: 舊詞，眼前的事：新增五語全文

summary.en: 6 essays in complete Japanese, French, German, Spanish and Korean editions, alongside English and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Arguments, examples and scope checked paragraph by paragraph.
summary.zh: 6 篇散文新增日文、法文、德文、西文与韩文完整版本，保留原有英文与简繁中文。逐段核对论述、事例与适用范围。
summary.zh-hant: 6 篇散文新增日文、法文、德文、西文與韓文完整版本，保留原有英文與簡繁中文。逐段核對論述、事例與適用範圍。
